address: Cardiff (Llanishen), Cardiff Business Park, Cardiff CF14 5GF
address_note: gov.uk's find-a-driving-test-centre, searched by postcode CF14 5GF on 2026-11-17, lists Cardiff (Llanishen) at Cardiff Business Park, CF14 5GF (car, ADI part 2 and part 3 tests; no wheelchair access). Its map pin, 51.52269,-3.19137, is about 70 m east of the given position. The given position is OpenStreetMap's DVSA test centre point (node/12141931941) on Lambourne Crescent in the business park, off Tŷ Glas Avenue: matches. Driving Test Tips' centre page gives Thornbury House, Unit 11 Lambourne Crescent, Cardiff Business Park, CF14 5GF. gov.uk lists no other car test centre in Cardiff: the route lists below, which all start on Norbury Road in Fairwater, 5 km south-west, describe the earlier Cardiff centre, so they are used for roads further out only, never for leaving and returning.

summary: 3 confirmed and 78 likely roads plus 1 confirmed and 7 likely junctions. The route lists (drivingtesttips.biz, copied by intensivelessons.co.uk) all start on Norbury Road, the earlier Fairwater centre 5 km away, so most of their roads are out of reach; the ones near Llanishen are in Heath (Caerphilly Road, Heathwood Road, Cefn Carnau Road, St Isan Road, Heathway, St Brigid Road) with five named junctions there, and a 2023 Llanishen route video and an instructor's 2026 video add Heathway, the A48, Gabalfa and the Morrisons roundabout. One route meeting the overlap rule looks possible (Caerphilly Road, Heath and the Morrisons roundabout); a second leaving the other way would rest mostly on the map.
